description: Preventive alert rules for the Airify demo. Each rule maps a demo PM2.5 display band to preventive, non-medical guidance. Alerts are PREVENTIVE INFORMATION ONLY — they are not diagnoses, not clinical decision support, and not treatment advice.

rules.headline: Lower estimated exposure right now.
guidance: Estimated environmental exposure is generally lower for this activity window.
Outdoor activity is generally reasonable at this level.

rules.headline: Some exposure expected — small planning choices may help.
guidance: Consider shorter outdoor durations when PM2.5 is elevated.
A well-fitted mask may reduce estimated exposure during outdoor travel.

rules.headline: Higher estimated exposure for this activity window.
guidance: Indoor spaces with air filtration may reduce estimated exposure.

rules.headline: Very high estimated environmental exposure.
guidance: Keep windows closed if indoor air is cleaner.
A well-fitted N95/KN95 mask may help if outdoor exposure is necessary.

rules.headline: Severe demo exposure band — reduce exposure where possible.
guidance: Consider staying indoors with filtered air where possible.
Reduce strenuous outdoor activity that raises breathing rate.
A well-fitted N95/KN95 mask may help if going outside is necessary.

population_modifiers.note: Sensitive groups may see the same rules surfaced one band earlier as a preventive trigger. This is a reference trigger, not a medical instruction.

boundary: Preventive information only. Environmental exposure estimate only. Not medical diagnosis. Not clinical decision support.
